title: Cost and price fields show only to a user who can see financial data
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second user, {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL User B), has the custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NOFIN ROLE), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' on and See Financial Data off, and access to {Location-A}.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser (or a private window).
  • Tracked part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOFIN-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. As {User-B}, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Turn the switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off.
  7. Turn the switch back on.
  8. Click Cancel.
  9. As {User-B}, click New Inventory Part.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the Admin sees Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge.
  • Step 5: {User-B} sees no Average Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field.
  • Step 6: Min and Max disappear.
  • Step 7: Min and Max show again.
  • Step 9: {User-B} sees no Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field in New Inventory Part.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R4a, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 1.6 (Branch: a new part with tracking off), board 5.2 (Switch off), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R4a: “Vendor always shows. Cost, Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge show only to a user who can see financial data. Min and Max show only while tracking is on (S4-R5).”
